_comment: GMGN Enhanced Screening — Professional LP settings for ~90% win rate
_note: Copy to gmgn-config.json and add your apiKey. GMGN provides deeper token quality data vs Meteora-only screening.
_kolNote: KOL presence validates social momentum = real traders entering. Require at least 2 KOLs for higher confidence. dump KOL detection: if a KOL holds < dumpKolMinHoldPct%, flag as dump risk (they exited).
preferredKolNames: Cooker.hl | Kms.eth | 版本之子 | Cooker
_rugNote: Rug/scam filters tightened vs defaults. maxBundlerRate 0.20 (was 0.50): bundled wallets = coordinated dump risk. maxRatTraderRate 0.10 (was 0.20): rat traders flip fast, they exit = price drops. maxFreshWalletRate 0.15 (was 0.20): fresh wallets = bots or snipers. maxSniperHoldRate 0.20 (was 0.30): snipers holding = potential coordinated dump. maxTop10HolderRate 0.40 (was 0.50): concentration risk.
_klineNote: Kline analysis for volume pattern validation. rejectSingleVolumeSpike=true: if 70%+ of 1h volume came from a single candle = flash pump, likely manipulated. Not real sustained volume.
_indicatorNote: Supertrend filter prevents entering tokens already in bearish momentum or at bottom of a collapse. requireBullishSupertrend=true: price must be in bullish supertrend (ascending momentum). rejectAlreadyAtBottom=true: if price is near recent low, don't LP (no volume to earn from). requireAboveSupertrend=false: keep false, too restrictive — bullish trend is enough.
